title: Enhanced SnO2 electron transport layers by Eu3+ doping for efficient and stable perovskite solar cells
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00128E, Paper
Danxia Wu, Huilin Yan, Xing Zhao, Yujie Qiu, Yuqing Yang, Yuanxi Zhang, Bingbing Fan, Peng Cui, Xin Sun, Pengjun Zhao, Meicheng Li
Europium chloride hexahydrate was added into the chemical bath deposition process of SnO2, in which Eu3+ successfully doped into SnO2 lattice, enhancing its electrical properties, increasing the efficiency and stability of perovskite solar cells.
